digest.component_or_area: LLM runner telemetry sink and weekly job instrumentation
propositions: Per-call LLM token usage (input/output/cache tokens and request count) is computed in PydanticAIRunner.run and attached as result["_usage"] but never surfaced to weekly GitHub Actions jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval), leaving no durable record of billable spend.

The runner's INFO log lines containing usage are suppressed by NullHandler on the rebar logger and neither weekly job invokes logging.basicConfig, so logs are lost; the langfuse-trace path exports to an ephemeral container torn down after each run.

A new opt-in REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable and usage_log.py module must record usage as JSONL lines at the existing _usage seam in PydanticAIRunner.run, with a no-op when unset, so both jobs capture spend via a single instrumentation point.
Both weekly jobs must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to a temp file path, append the summarize() Markdown output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY if always(), and upload the raw JSONL artifact for durable retrieval.

Unit tests must validate record() and summarize() behavior, verify record() is a no-op when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset, and confirm the runner seam fires via FunctionModel-override path without live calls.
runner.py must remain at or under 800 LOC after adding the single usage_log.record() call.
